text:
Nora: Quick idea  run a set of 45m mini-dryrun sessions for onboarding customers doing small-scale Dedicated tests. Aim: short, timezone-friendly, repeated slots instead of one long workshop.
Hector: Love it. What's the cadence you're thinking? Daily for a week?
Nora: Proposal: 3x 45m slots/day for one week (AM PT, mid-day EU-friendly, evening APAC). Keep each session focused: smoke test, one common blocker, and a 10m feedback pulse.
Aisha: I can run the smoke test demo and a tiny checklist. Can we limit the hands-on lab to 8 seats so it's still interactive?
Ben (CS): Agree on cap. We'll need a prereg form and a fast triage sheet so we can route accounts to correct slot (infra vs app). I can build the form.
enablement-bot: Note: upload any session artifacts to /Enablement/MiniDryRun/ and tag #enablement by EOD before the first slot.
Hector: For follow-up, suggest a 2-question NPS-style pulse after each session and a checkbox for "ready to proceed to full migration" so AEs can act quickly.
Aisha: Also include a tiny runbook snippet: how to switch to fallback model during a spike. I can draft that.
Nora: Logistics: volunteers to help run rooms and watch for ticket escalations? We'll need 3 facilitators per slot (demo, breakout helper, ticket triage). React with :hand: if available.
Ben (CS): I'll own scheduling + form + calendar series. Form fields: company, technical lead, timezone, blocker category, prefer hands-on (y/n). Will DM AEs a short invite list first.
Hector: I can do demo Tuesday/Thursday AM PT. Aisha can do Wed/Friday APAC-friendly slots?
Aisha: Yes I can take those. Also propose we record each slot and auto-generate a timestamped snippet of the demo for the repo. QA-runner-bot can we auto-trim recordings to the demo segment?
QA-runner-bot: Currently set to record full session. I can add a post-processing tag that timestamps demo start/end if hosts add the marker "[DEMO START]" and "[DEMO END]" in chat.
Nora: Nice. We'll ask presenters to drop markers. For invitations, need a 1-line blurb and a short preread (3 bullet checklist). Can someone draft the blurb?
Hector: Draft blurb: "45m Mini Dry Run: focused smoke test and live troubleshooting to clear blockers before Dedicated migration. Seats limited  reserve your slot." Short and punchy.
Aisha: Preread bullets: 1) access keys ready, 2) minimal test dataset loaded, 3) current autoscale config. Keep it one page.
Ben (CS): Action items:
- Ben: form + calendar series + calendar invites (by EOD today)
- Aisha: preread + demo markers + runbook snippet (by Tue)
- Hector: demo slides + 3 common troubleshooting scenarios (by Tue)
- Nora: confirm AE invite list + publish internal note (tomorrow)
Ben (CS): Form live: https://forms.gle/minidryrun-xyz  internal only. Adding waitlist logic once seats fill. Will post attendee count snapshot hourly once registrations begin.
Nora: Also want to capture a short "post-session action" column for each attendee (ready to migrate / needs follow-up / needs deeper workshop). That makes handoffs to AEs explicit.
Hector: :hand: to help triage follow-ups.
Aisha: :hand: for breakout lab ops.
Ben (CS): Adding a tag to calendar event: "PostAction: Ready/FollowUp/DeepDive" so CS can export and hand off to AEs.
enablement-bot: Reminder: finalize assets to /Enablement/MiniDryRun/ before first session.
Nora: Great work team. Aim to open signups 48 hours before first slot. Closing thread for planning  post updates here only so we keep the audit trail.
